# Text Input

An input allows people to enter short, free form text data. If you need to collect more than one line of information, try a textarea.

**Stylesheet:** `components/text-input/text-input.css`

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## 

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Label text displayed above the input. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | — | Placeholder text shown when the field is empty. |
| `size` | `'md' \| 'lg'` | `'lg'` | Input height — medium (32px) or large (40px). |
| `type` | `'text' \| 'number' \| 'password' \| 'email' \| 'tel'` | `'text'` | HTML input type. |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'lighter' \| 'darker'` | `'default'` | Visual style variant controlling background color. |
| `value` | `string` | `''` | Current value of the input. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Prevents user interaction. |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Makes the content non-editable but copyable. |
| `error` | `boolean` | `false` | Applies error styling (red border). |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field as required (asterisk on label). |
| `helper-text` | `string` | — | Descriptive hint text displayed below the field. |
| `icon` | `leading \| trailing` | — | Icon position inside the input field. |
| `addon-type` | `'text' \| 'dropdown'` | `'text'` | Prefix/suffix type — plain text or interactive dropdown with chevron. |
| `addon-style` | `'solid' \| 'subtle'` | `'solid'` | Prefix/suffix visual style — solid (gray bg) or subtle (transparent). |

## States

All interactive states — default, filled, disabled, read-only, and focus (click to see).

```html
<div class="text-input" style="max-width: 280px;">
    <label class="text-input__label">Default</label>
    <input type="text" class="text-input__field" placeholder="Placeholder">
</div>
<div class="text-input" style="max-width: 280px;">
    <label class="text-input__label">Filled</label>
    <input type="text" class="text-input__field" value="Input text">
</div>
<div class="text-input text-input--disabled" style="max-width: 280px;">
    <label class="text-input__label">Disabled</label>
    <input type="text" class="text-input__field" placeholder="Placeholder" disabled="">
</div>


<div class="text-input text-input--disabled" style="max-width: 280px;">
    <label class="text-input__label">Disabled filled</label>
    <input type="text" class="text-input__field" value="Input text" disabled="">
</div>
<div class="text-input" style="max-width: 280px;">
    <label class="text-input__label">Read-only</label>
    <input type="text" class="text-input__field" value="Read-only value" readonly="">
</div>
```

## Validation

Error and success validation states with helper text feedback.

        </svg>
        Please enter a valid email address.

</div>

## Sizes

Two size options — medium (32px) for compact layouts and large (40px, default) for standard forms.

```html
<div class="text-input" style="max-width: 280px;">
    <label class="text-input__label">Medium (32px)</label>
    <input type="text" class="text-input__field text-input__field--md" placeholder="Medium input">
</div>
<div class="text-input" style="max-width: 280px;">
    <label class="text-input__label">Large (40px) — Default</label>
    <input type="text" class="text-input__field" placeholder="Large input">
</div>
```

        <input type="tel" class="text-input__field" placeholder="٩٦٦ ٥X XXX XXXX+">
    </div>
    <span class="text-input__helper">أدخل رقم الهاتف مع رمز الدولة.</span>
</div>
